preview.overview: Baylor travels to Provo to face BYU with the College Football Belt on the line in a matchup between two teams with very different trajectories this season. The Cougars hold a 3-2 edge in the all-time series and beat Baylor 34-28 just last year, making this a chance for BYU to reassert dominance in a rivalry that has seen recent momentum shift.
key_matchups: Baylor's offensive firepower versus BYU's recent defensive performance—the Bears scored 42, 41, and 55 points in three of their last five games, while BYU has surrendered 28, 39, and 39 points in losses this season
BYU's ability to execute in close games, having won 28-24 vs Notre Dame and 27-20 vs Arizona State, against a Baylor team that just lost 24-25 at Kansas
Baylor's turnover risk on the road after consecutive losses to Kansas and TCU (17 and 25 points allowed) versus BYU's home-field advantage at a venue where the Cougars won their last two games
preview.betting_angles: BYU won the most recent meeting 34-28 and hold a 3-2 series advantage, suggesting historical comfort in this matchup. However, Baylor showed dominant scoring ability in its last three wins (42, 41, and 55 points) before consecutive losses, while BYU has been vulnerable to offensive pressure, conceding 39 points at UCF and 28 points to Utah. The recency of form points in different directions: Baylor's last two outings were close losses, while BYU just beat Iowa State 24-10 after winning 28-24 over Notre Dame.
preview.prediction_writeup: BYU's edge in the head-to-head series (3-2) and their 34-28 victory last year give the Cougars familiarity with Baylor's attack. While Baylor has shown explosive offensive capability with wins of 42-31, 41-9, and 55-19, the Bears' recent form is concerning—consecutive defeats to Kansas (24-25) and TCU (6-17) suggest vulnerability that BYU can exploit at home. The Cougars have proven they can win close games this season, defeating Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona State 27-20, and holding Baylor to 28 points last year on the road suggests the defense knows how to contain this offense. Baylor's road struggles and BYU's home record make this a favorable spot for the belt to change hands in Provo.
